transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Hello, this is Microsoft Security Division calling. We've detected a critical virus on your computer.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: Oh really? I didn't notice anything wrong.

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Our systems have flagged your IP address. This is an official government-level warning. Your account will be suspended and all your files deleted within 2 hours if we don't act immediately.

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Yes, this is extremely urgent. As a certified Microsoft technician, I need you to download our verification tool right now so we can remotely remove the threat.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: Is this safe? How do I know you're really from Microsoft?

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Ma'am, I am an authorized federal officer working with Microsoft. This is a legal matter now. Your failure to cooperate will result in your internet being permanently blocked.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: I don't want that to happen...

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Then act now. Go to this website immediately and we'll fix the problem. Don't delay — every second counts.
